units.source_text: 自从失去你以后，我对花香鸟语索然乏味，对一切都感到落寞虚空。

en.t: Ever since I lost you, the fragrance of flowers and the songs of birds have felt dull to me, and everything has seemed lonely and empty.

units.source_text: 天地万物和我的灵魂之间的通道顿时完全被截断了。

en.t: In that instant, the passage between all things in heaven and earth and my soul was completely cut off.

units.source_text: 我悲伤失去了恋人，但更悲伤失去了一颗爱情的心。

en.t: I grieved that I had lost my beloved, but I grieved even more that I had lost a heart capable of love.
